item.title: Deterministic Cost Anomaly Detection
item.description:
Amazon Athena Anomaly Detection AWS Cost Anomaly Detection

Estimated duration: 15 mins

Deterministic Cost Anomaly Detection

Overview

The custom engine is intentionally simple and transparent: historical baseline, actual cost, absolute delta, percentage delta, and a dual-threshold decision.

Learning Objectives

  • Understand the baseline.
  • Understand absolute and percentage materiality.
  • Explain why dual thresholds reduce noise.
  • Compare with AWS Cost Anomaly Detection.

Why This Matters for FinOps

Deterministic rules are valuable when the team needs predictable, testable behavior. Managed ML remains useful for adaptive production monitoring.

item.title: Cost Driver Analysis & Quick Integration
item.description:
Amazon Athena Amazon Quick Sight Amazon Quick

Estimated duration: 20 mins

Cost Driver Analysis & Quick Integration

Overview

An anomaly says something changed. Cost-driver analysis identifies which account, service, Region, or usage type contributed to the change.

Learning Objectives

  • Rank positive cost drivers.
  • Separate offsets from increases.
  • Publish structured evidence.
  • Use Quick only after numerical evidence exists.

Why This Matters for FinOps

Grounded investigation is easier when the analytical engine has already narrowed the change to concrete dimensions and contributions.
